title: Anagram Checker
description: Write a Zig program that checks if two strings are anagrams of each other.
hints: Anagrams have the same character frequency
Use an array of 26 counters for 'a' to 'z'
The `**` operator repeats an array: `[_]u8{0} ** 26` creates 26 zeros
Use `-|=` for saturating subtraction to prevent underflow
